interventions.description: Myo-inositol powder, 4 g daily, dissolved in water.
interventions.name: Myo-Inositol 4 g

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study evaluates myo-inositol supplementation over 6 months in women with polycystic ovary syndrome.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female, age 18 to 45 years
* Diagnosis of polycystic ovary syndrome by Rotterdam criteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy or planned pregnancy during the study
* Use of hormonal contraception within 2 months

identificationModule.briefTitle: Inositol Therapy for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Study of Myo-Inositol in Women With Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
